Frontend (Playwright, super_admin session): (1) Instructor Dashboard loads, /api/cohorts + /api/submissions + /api/analytics/dashboard all resolve, 4 cohort cards render, no 'Failed to load data' toast; (2) Material Library at /library loads, filter=all=6, filter=weekly=6, filter=global=0, filter=video=0, filter=all after switching still 6 with unique IDs (no double-render, no skip); consistency weekly+global==all holds; 2 lib-homework edit-feedback-template Sparkles buttons render as expected; upload dialog shows lib-feedback-template-input only when material_type=homework (hidden for workbook, appears when switched to homework); (3) Submission Detail loads for super_admin; (4) Progress Tracking loads and Weekly Progress renders Week 1 -> 2 -> 3 in strict ascending order (useMemo sort with [...arr].sort() confirmed non-mutating); (5) Coach Max page loads with empty chat history AND ZERO chat/history console errors (404-silent branch works); (6) Auth /me returns 200 super_admin, POST /api/auth/logout returns 200; (7) Branding: /api/settings/branding populated -> document.title='The Boost Pad', CSS var --brand-primary='#22438E' applied. minor.issue: 10 pre-existing failures (auth-setup returning 401 for chat_audio + submission_audio + serve_audio; video transcription 'failed' status). Explicitly flagged as pre-existing and unrelated to this refactor pass in the review request. NOT caused by the is True -> == True operator swap.

critical_code_review_comments: ProgressTracking.js:178-190 & 192-199 fetchCohorts and fetchCohortAnalytics are still bare inline functions (not wrapped in useCallback) yet they are called from useEffects with [isInstructor] and [selectedCohort] deps respectively. This is functionally fine but inconsistent with the pattern applied to InstructorDashboard/MaterialLibrary/SubmissionDetail/CoachMaxPage in this pass — could produce eslint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings. If option (a) intended to normalize the fetcher pattern across all pages, ProgressTracking was missed.

CoachMaxPage.js:29-48 handlePlayAudio uses toast.error but its underscored variable name _e signals a suppressed exception with no logging. Not part of the 'safe pass' scope but the same fix pattern (console.warn on non-404) would improve observability of TTS failures.

AuthContext.js:52-58 checkAuth catch swallows the error silently (only clears user + token). A console.warn on non-401 errors would match the observability pattern applied to logout/setRole. 401 is expected but 5xx would go silent.

MaterialLibrary.js:137-151 & MaterialsTab.js:255-268 handleEditFeedbackTemplate still uses window.prompt() (already flagged in iteration_34). Not fixed in this refactor pass — option (a) skipped it. Confirming it remains an outstanding UX/browser-compat concern.
InstructorDashboard.js:80 handleCreateCohort chains fetchData() on same line as } catch (error) { — visually confusing but syntactically fine. Minor style nit for future formatter pass.

Verified: (a) console.warn/error fallbacks emit as designed on failure paths (logout, setRole, branding, chat history non-404); (b) useCallback + reordered deps do not cause infinite re-renders or stale closures on any tested page; (c) [...arr].sort() inside useMemo no longer mutates analytics.weekly_progress state (verified by ascending Week 1->2->3 render on ProgressTracking); (d) MaterialLibrary useMemo correctly re-computes filteredMaterials when filter state changes without dropping or duplicating items; (e) the 'is True'/'is False' -> '== True'/'== False' pytest swap is semantically equivalent for MongoDB return values (Python True == True and dict.get('bool_field')==True both hold) and did not regress any of the 51 tests exercising it.
